front.title: Referrals to Holder-Designated RDAP Services for Subordinate Resources

abstract.t: An RDAP query can be followed from the IANA bootstrap registries down to the most specific object a registry operator holds, and no further. When the holder of a registered resource keeps registration data for resources below it, such as names below a registered domain or more-specific networks below an address allocation, and publishes that data from an RDAP service of its own, a client has no in-band way to find that service. This document describes how a registry operator refers clients to such a holder-designated service. The registry redirects lookups for subordinate resources to the holder's service, so an unchanged client receives the most specific record as it would from any other redirect. On top of that, the covering object can advertise the holder's service, so a client that cares can discover the delegation and cross the authority boundary knowingly. The document uses the redirect controls and object relations of draft-ietf-regext-rdap-referrals and the service relations of draft- ietf-regext-rdap-extensions, and defines no new ones.
